## Soft Metadata

> [!WARNING]
> **Tier 2 (community estimate)** — Soft Metadata below adapted from IEEE publisher pages and domain knowledge of IEEE SMC (Systems, Man, and Cybernetics) Society editorial culture. Submission practitioners are invited to upgrade individual claims to Tier 1 via `/ja-validate`. See [SEED_DATA_QUALITY.md](../../../../SEED_DATA_QUALITY.md) for the Skeleton → Tier 2 → Tier 1 lifecycle.

> **The core value of this entry.** OpenAlex cannot fill any of these — they require lived experience and community knowledge. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](../../../../CONTRIBUTING.md) for guidance.

### Epistemological & Political Leanings

| Dimension | Assessment |
|-----------|------------|
| **Cross-cultural friendliness** | High |
| **Non-Western epistemology openness** | Low — paradigm-unified engineering |
| **Diversity topic receptiveness** | Medium |
| **Dominant theoretical tradition** | Human-machine systems engineering — human-automation, supervisory control, human factors engineering, cybernetics, intelligent system interfaces |

### Framing Requirements

- **Mandatory framing?** Yes (strong)
- **If yes, what kind?** Manuscripts must demonstrate **engineering / systems contribution to human-machine interaction**. IEEE SMC Society scope.
- **Consequences of ignoring it**: Pure HCI redirected to TOCHI; pure psychology redirected to Human Factors.

## Strategic Notes

### Hard Blockers

- Pure HCI without engineering / systems focus
- AI use without disclosure per IEEE policy

### Soft Tax

Low for IEEE SMC tradition.

### Best Suited For

- Human-automation engineering
- Supervisory control systems
- Intelligent interface engineering
- Cybernetics applications

### Not Recommended For

- Pure HCI (consider TOCHI)
- Pure psychology (consider Human Factors)
- Pure AI without human-system framing

### Rejection Fallback Chain

| Rank | Journal | Why this fallback works |
|------|---------|------------------------|
| 1 | [IEEE Access](./ieee-access.md) | IEEE OA mega-journal |
| 2 | [Human Factors](./human-factors.md) | HFES ergonomics if applied focus |
| 3 | [International Journal of Human-Computer Interaction](./international-journal-of-human-computer-interaction.md) | T&F applied HCI |

**Reverse direction** *(optional)*: If your paper was rejected from Human Factors as "too engineering," IEEE THMS is the IEEE SMC home.
